user.title: Connect Price Watch
user.description: Enter the URL and scoped API token for your private Price Watch service.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the Price Watch service.
error.timeout: The Price Watch service did not respond in time.
error.invalid_response: The Price Watch service returned an invalid health response.
error.invalid_url: Enter an HTTPS URL for production or non-local service endpoints. The only HTTP exceptions are local/test endpoints: use homeassistant.local for a local Home Assistant service, localhost for local use, or price-watch.test for tests. IP-literal and public HTTP destinations are rejected. Do not include credentials, query parameters, or fragments.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one Price Watch service can be configured until the API exposes a stable service instance ID.
